everyday.title: Everyday Money
everyday.blurb: Banking, budgeting, saving and borrowing. Practise freely — nothing here changes your character's money.

no_effects: This was practice. Your character's money and meters are unchanged — only what you learned carries over.

document-hunt.title: Document Hunt
document-hunt.blurb: Find what the bank actually needs to open an account in your name.

swipe-sort.title: Need or Want?
swipe-sort.blurb: Sort spending into needs and wants — and find out why context changes the answer.

debt-ladder.title: The Cost of Borrowing
debt-ladder.blurb: You need ₹2,000 for three months. Four ways to get it. Which costs least?

rescue-mission.title: Rescue Mission
rescue-mission.blurb: A friend lost money to a fake job site. What do you do, and in what order?
